title: One end-to-end ecosystem setup command
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. 'susi setup' detects hardware, engines, keys and agents, proposes one plan with consents batched, applies it, and prints a summary; safe to rerun. Integration test zc_setup_workflow.rs.
